{{DISPLAYTITLE:ML_TYPE}}
{{TAGDEF|ML_TYPE|kernel {{!}} vasp {{!}} grace | kernel}}

Description: String-based tag selecting type of machine-learned force field to use. {{available|6.6.0}}
----
Given that machine-learned force fields are enabled ({{TAG|ML_LMLFF|.TRUE.}}) this tag selects which type of force field is used.

<ul>
<li>{{TAG|ML_TYPE|kernel, vasp}}: <p>Use {{VASP}}'s native [[#Category:Machine-learned_force_fields|machine-learned force fields]] with theoretical background described [[Machine_learning_force_field:_Theory|here]]. The strings <code>kernel</code> and <code>vasp</code> are synonymous in this context.</p>
<li>{{TAG|ML_TYPE|grace}}: <p>Use [[Running_GRACE_force_fields_in_VASP|GRACE force fields]], available only for {{TAG|ML_MODE|run}} if [[Makefile.include#GRACE_support|GRACE support]] is enabled at compile time.</p>
</ul>
